## Overview

Fix presentation view navigation in the GitHub Copilot Canvas Extension. This release
also adds regression coverage for Canvas navigation and preview modes.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible. No changes to existing Markdown decks, CLI
arguments, or the VS Code integration protocol are required.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.6.2`. |
